"''Yes, sir! Move all quadrants to sector 5-1-5.|Yoda and the Clone Captain|}} A '''Clone Captain''' served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. The [[clone trooper]] [[captain]] participated in the [[First Battle of Geonosis]] alongside [[Jedi]] [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]] and was present in the [[Forward Command Center|forward command center]] during the battle. They ordered all quadrants to move to [[Sector 5-1-5 (Geonosis)|sector 5-1-5]] after receiving orders from [[Jedi Master|Master]] Yoda. ==Biography== The [[Clone Captain]] was part of an [[army]] of [[clone trooper]]s that were [[Cloning|grown]] from the [[DNA|genetic]] [[Clone template|template]] of the [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]] on [[Kamino]]. With the formation of the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] at the onset of the [[Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' the [[captain]] participated in the [[First Battle of Geonosis]] where they were stationed in a [[Forward Command Center|forward command center]] along with a [[Unidentified Clone Commander (Geonosis)|Clone Commander]] and [[Jedi]] [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]]. Yoda ordered all fire be concentrated on the nearest [[starship]], so the captain ordered all quadrants to [[Sector 5-1-5 (Geonosis)|sector 5-1-5]]. Following this, the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Self-Propelled Heavy Artillery|SPHA-Ts]] fired on a [[core ship]]. ==Equipment== This clone [[trooper]] captain wore [[Phase I clone trooper armor]] with [[Color|red]] markings to signify their [[Military rank|rank]]. ==Appearances== *{{Film|II}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Clone trooper captains]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
